scope: Four exact lesson teaching ties from three original articles. One Harvard push-up document supports two separate variants. No complete-lesson, dose, personal-safety or camera validation.
heldReason: ACE one-leg lift follows pelvic-floor/core co-contraction protocol that cal-35 does not teach; keep existing pregnancy adaptation and course body unchanged.

strongfirst_wall_hinge.locator: The Wall Hinge Builds the Base Movement, lines 32-43

supports.en: Hip movement backward to a gentle wall tap, followed by returning upright.
supports.tr: Kalçayı hafifçe duvara değene kadar geriye götürüp yeniden dikleşmeyi.

doesNotSupport.en: A prescribed wall distance, rep dose, lumbar angle, safety threshold or camera form verdict.
doesNotSupport.tr: Sabit duvar mesafesini, tekrar dozunu, bel açısını, güvenlik eşiğini veya kamera form hükmünü.

strongfirst_wall_hinge.rights: Teaching text attribution only; commercial imagery/audio/video reuse and model-training rights not verified.
